name: Charlie in Underworld
source:
Underworld Office, in Underworld Station, where the living and ghosts are intertwined. Charlie opens their eyes there but doesn't remember a thing. In order to find their memory, Charlie needs the help of ghosts who are so full of personality, they're overflowing with uniqueness. But things don't go as planned. At all.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.buffstudio.uwoffice2.charlie.free.visual.novel.adventure.story.games]English Google Play[/url]]
translation:
阴间车站中的阴间事务所，是生者与鬼魂交汇的地方。查理在这里睁开双眼，却什么也想不起来。为了找回记忆，查理需要那些个性鲜明、各有怪癖的鬼魂们帮助。然而，事情的发展完全不如预期。一点也不。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.buffstudio.uwoffice2.charlie.free.visual.novel.adventure.story.games]Google Play英文版[/url]]
